hypotheses.U1_human_categories_leave_structure: Sixteen discovery residual axes recover at least 20 percent of held-out routing error beyond human-category centroids.
hypotheses.U2_residual_axes_beat_random: Sixteen residual axes beat the p95 of 32 matched random subspaces by at least 0.10 residual recovery.
hypotheses.U3_multiple_residual_axes_are_stable: At least eight of the first 32 axes match an independent split with absolute cosine at least 0.70.
hypotheses.U4_unknown_axes_exist: At least three stable axes have cross-split token-score correlation at least 0.60 and absolute correlation below 0.50 with every existing token feature.
hypotheses.U5_residual_recovery_scales_with_rank: Held-out residual recovery increases monotonically across ranks 4, 8, 16, 32, and 64.
